text_block_list.text:
Can you feel the excitement in the air,
Тренер?
You could cut the tension with
a knife.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The eyes of the crowd are on us,
watching our
every move.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A fitting stage to demonstrate my skills,
don't you
agree?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But of course. Victory is the podium from
which
the Emperor leads her people!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
